stories.title: The Photo in the Ardennes
stories.description: A World War II soldier talks to the camera as the battle unfolds, in short 6-second scenes for 24fps generation.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the SAME World War II infantry soldier, Elias, speaking directly to the camera. Caucasian male, mid-20s, narrow face, light stubble, small scar above left eyebrow. Frosted M1 helmet, snow on skin, intense eye contact with the lens. Smoke behind him, distant artillery flashes reflecting faintly on his face. Active WWII battlefield.
scenes.motion_prompt: locked frontal framing, very slow cinematic push-in, natural mouth and jaw movement while speaking, subtle head micro-movements, blinking, visible breath in cold air, faint micro tremor from distant artillery, snow drifting softly, light flicker from off-screen explosions
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: I’m in the Ardennes right now. It’s freezing.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the SAME soldier Elias still speaking to the camera, eye contact unwavering. Helmet rim frosted, cheeks dirty, breath visible. Smoke thickens behind him and flashes are closer now.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push-in continues, subtle facial tension, natural speaking mouth movement, brief soft vibration from distant impact, snow and tiny debris drifting, light flicker intensifies, camera remains stable
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: Shells keep landing out there. Every second feels like it could be the one.
